title: Concurrent driver mutations induce distinct tumour morphologies on radiological imaging.
authors: Rodriguez Sanchez, Diana Ivonne; Vanneste, Thera; Middelkoop, Julian; Maxouri, Olga; Rostami, Sajjad; Ursprung, Stephan; Boveradze, Nino; Chupetlovska, Kalina; Castagnoli, Francesca; Landolfi, Federica; Hong, Eun Kyoung; Pizzi, Andrea Delli; Gennaro, Nicolo; Snaebjornsson, Petur; Bodalal, Zuhir; Beets-Tan, Regina
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用CT影像组学分析癌症驱动基因共突变与肿瘤形态的关联，属于纯影像-基因组学关联研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Most radiogenomic studies examine single driver mutations in isolation, despite evidence that co-occurring driver alterations are common and functionally interacting in cancer. Whether concurrent mutations produce distinct imaging phenotypes or simply average single-mutation effects remains unknown. METHODS: A multi-cancer cohort of 1235 patients with 8633 segmented lesions from contrast-enhanced CT scans and matched genomic profiling was retrospectively assembled. Patients with no driver mutations, TP53 + other mutations, TP53-only, EGFR-only, KRAS-only, and strictly TP53 + EGFR or TP53 + KRAS mutations were compared. Primary analyses were conducted in the original feature space at the patient level (via median aggregation). Separation between mutation groups was quantified using centroid distance and cross-group inter-patient distance with 1000 patient-aware label-stratified bootstraps. Lesion-level dimensionality reduction was used for descriptive visualisation and mixed-effects models adjusted for tumour site. A cross-validated parental-axis geometry analysis tested emergence beyond additivity. RESULTS: Single-mutant cohorts formed distinct phenotypes: EGFR-only versus KRAS-only centroid distance 18.4 (95% CI = 12.0-23.8); TP53-only versus EGFR-only 16.9 (12.3-21.3). Co-mutated tumours were separate from parents in the patient-level and lesion-level space. Patient-level centroid distances were TP53-only versus TP53 + EGFR = 13.4 (10.1-16.9); EGFR-only versus TP53 + EGFR = 7.7 (5.3-11.6); TP53-only versus TP53 + KRAS = 6.4 (4.5-9.1). Co-mutated lesions were morphologically closer to TP53-only than to the EGFR-only or KRAS-only cohort (Mahalanobis p < 0.001). Emergence beyond additivity was supported for TP53 + EGFR (off-axis p = 0.009) and trended for TP53 + KRAS (p = 0.062). CONCLUSIONS: Across different cancers, CT radiomics identified genotype-specific phenotypes and showed that co-mutations produce distinct morphologies. Co-mutation context should be modelled explicitly in radiogenomics and prospectively validated for non-invasive molecular stratification.
abstract_zh: 背景：大多数放射基因组学研究孤立地考察单一驱动突变，尽管有证据表明共现驱动改变在癌症中常见且功能上相互作用。并发突变是否产生独特的影像表型，或仅仅是单一突变效应的平均，仍属未知。方法：回顾性构建了一个多癌种队列，包含1235名患者，来自增强CT扫描的8633个分割病灶及匹配的基因组分析。比较了无驱动突变、TP53+其他突变、仅TP53、仅EGFR、仅KRAS，以及严格TP53+EGFR或TP53+KRAS突变的患者。主要分析在原始特征空间的患者层面（通过中位数聚合）进行。突变组间的分离通过质心距离和跨组患者间距离量化，使用1000次患者感知标签分层自助抽样。病灶层面降维用于描述性可视化，并采用调整肿瘤部位的混合效应模型。交叉验证的父轴几何分析测试了超越加和性的涌现。结果：单突变队列形成独特表型：仅EGFR与仅KRAS的质心距离为18.4（95% CI = 12.0-23.8）；仅TP53与仅EGFR为16.9（12.3-21.3）。共突变肿瘤在患者层面和病灶层面空间中与父本组分离。患者层面质心距离为：仅TP53与TP53+EGFR = 13.4（10.1-16.9）；仅EGFR与TP53+EGFR = 7.7（5.3-11.6）；仅TP53与TP53+KRAS = 6.4（4.5-9.1）。共突变病灶在形态上更接近仅TP53组，而非仅EGFR或仅KRAS组（马氏距离p < 0.001）。超越加和性的涌现支持TP53+EGFR（离轴p = 0.009），并在TP53+KRAS中呈趋势（p = 0.062）。结论：在不同癌症中，CT放射组学识别出基因型特异性表型，并显示共突变产生独特形态。共突变背景应在放射基因组学中显式建模，并前瞻性验证用于非侵入性分子分层。
